It was a quiet night. Fresh snow danced around the sky before landing on their cheeks and snouts.
Volkyn (that’s the dragon) gives the wolf a pathetic look.
"Lyllith… <pause>P-please let me use your cloak… <pause>I’m so c-c-c-cold…"
Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.
Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.
Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.
This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.
But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.
And despite it being a joke at first…
It’s the little gestures that really get to him.
